property.value: [Trait] NEEDS TO LEARN HUMILITY When Thor takes damage from an opponent's attack, give him a number of Humility tokens equal to the damage clicked. FREE: Remove any number of Humility tokens. For each token removed, modify either attack or damage +1 until your next turn.

When an Odin's Favor token is given, after resolutions roll a d6. [d:5]-[d:6]: Replace Odin with [set:trm] #002 or [set:trm] #007 Loki on the same click number plus 1.
[Trait] GAIN ODIN'S FAVOR Each time a friendly character with the Asgardian keyword hits an opposing character, immediately give them an Odin's Favor token. Friendly characters with one more Odin's Favor tokens modify attack +1.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] HOLOGRAPHIC PROJECTION Grandmaster's actions don't count against your action total, his combat values can't be modified, and he takes a maximum of 1 damage from a range attack.
[Trait] MASTER MANIPULATOR At the beginning of your turn, you may turn Grandmaster to another click. If you do, at the end of your turn, roll a d6 and turn Grandmaster to that click number. He can't be healed in any other way.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] SWALLOW YOU WHOLE Each time Fenris Wolf KO's an opposing character, after resolutions give it a Growth token. If it has one Growth token it has Giant. If it has two or more Growth tokens it has Colossal. If it has three or more Growth tokens modify all combat values by +1.
[Attack] POWERFUL JAWS Powers: Blades Claws Fangs Blades/Claws/Fangs. When Fenris Wolf uses Blades/Claws/Fangs, increase the result of the d6 roll by the number of Growth tokens it has.
[Defense] MONSTROUS WOLF Powers: Super Senses, Toughness Super Senses, Toughness.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Trait] I HAVE BROUGHT THE ARMY OF THE DEAD TO THE GATES OF ASGARD Hela starts the game with a Rise! token. When a character that isn't a bystander is KO'd, heal Hela 1 click and give her a Rise! token. FREE: Remove a Rise! token to generate a Fallen Warrior bystander.
